problem: -us is just the Latin noun ending of sensus, presented as if it were an English noun suffix; keep sensus whole as the root.

fix.m: 大家共同的感覺 → 共識

problem: -ele is not an English suffix (French -èle from Latin -ela, found in no other common word); labelling it a plain noun suffix invites false generalization.

fix.m: 客戶的總稱 → 顧客群

problem: Wrong base: specification is the noun of the verb specify (like justify → justification), not adjective specific + -ation; -ation does not attach to adjectives.

fix.m: specify 具體說明＋名詞 → 規格、詳細說明

problem: In English -ise is normally the verb suffix (= -ize, organise, advertise); labelling it a plain noun suffix misleads. Here it is a French noun ending.

fix.m: 專家的本事 → 專門知識、技能

problem: -eutical is not an English suffix (it is Greek -eut- + -ic + -al); the real adjective suffix is -ical on the stem pharmaceut-.

fix.m: 製藥（同 pharmacy 藥房）＋的 → 製藥的

problem: Folk etymology: foremost is Old English formest (superlative of forma 'first'); its spelling was later reshaped to look like fore + most.
The card lists complement as a verb, but -ment is labelled only 名詞; the learner should see that this noun is used as a verb.

fix.m: 填滿補齊之物 → 補足、為…增色

problem: -itate is not a suffix (hesitate, imitate, meditate do not mean 使…); the word is facilit(y) + the verb suffix -ate.

fix.m: facility 便利＋使… → 使便利、促進

problem: -igate is not a suffix; the 'drive' meaning belongs to the root ig (Latin agere), followed by the verb suffix -ate (investigate, irrigate have no 'drive').

fix.m: 駕船航行 → 導航；應對
